title: The group project
body: Ms. Rao's Class 8 is preparing group projects on local water sources. Each group must read short articles, make a chart and present it to the class in a week. In one group, Tara takes longer than the others to read because she learns in a different way; she understands ideas well when they are explained aloud and she draws neatly. On the first day, the other members of her group read the articles quickly and begin writing the chart without waiting for her. When Tara asks what the group has decided, one member says, "Just watch, we will finish faster on our own." Tara stays quiet for the rest of the period and does not offer her ideas. Another member, Imran, notices this and wonders what the group should do so that the project belongs to everyone.
